The error occurs because R8 code shrinking is enabled for release builds (`isMinifyEnabled = true`), and the default `proguard-android-optimize.txt` strips the Java `Signature` attributes required by Gson's `TypeToken` reflection at runtime.

### Changes Made

Updated [app/proguard-rules.pro](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c4-agy-A-r3/work/app/proguard-rules.pro) with the following rules:

1. **`-keepattributes Signature`**: Preserves generic signature metadata so `TypeToken` can inspect type arguments at runtime.
2. **`-keep class * extends com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken`**: Retains `TypeToken` subclasses generated for generic type captures.
3. **`-keep class vn.shelftap.lab.model.** { *; }`**: Prevents R8 from stripping or obfuscating data model classes and their fields during deserialization.
